user.title: Connect to Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
user.description: Enter your DashScope API key and pick the region your key belongs to. Keys are region-specific: a Singapore key will not work against the Beijing endpoint.

data_description.api_key: Created in the Model Studio console under API keys.
data_description.region: Choose Custom to enter a workspace-scoped or self-hosted endpoint.
data_description.chat_model: Pick a listed model or type any model ID, including a pinned snapshot such as qwen3.7-plus-2026-04-02.

endpoint.title: Custom endpoint
endpoint.description: Enter the OpenAI-compatible base URL, for example {example}. The websocket URL used for CosyVoice is derived from the same host unless you override it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your API key
reauth_confirm.description: Alibaba Cloud rejected the stored DashScope API key. Enter a new one to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the endpoint. Check the URL and your network.
error.invalid_auth: Alibaba Cloud rejected this API key. Check that it matches the selected region.

data_description.prompt: Instructions the model is given before every conversation.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Leave empty to answer questions only, without controlling devices.
data_description.enable_thinking: Lets the model reason before answering. More accurate but noticeably slower, so it is off by default for voice.
data_description.tts_voice: CosyVoice voices belong to a specific model generation and are not interchangeable. Change the model first, then reopen this page to see the matching voices.
data_description.stt_model: Qwen-ASR auto-detects the spoken language when the pipeline does not specify one.
